description: CloudWatch logs for one environment of a RoboSystems deployment: ingest volume per log group, errors and security events across services, API failures and slow requests, Graph API query latency by database, and the live log streams of each service. Pick the CloudWatch datasource and environment at the top; Level and Search filter the log panels.

panels.description: Mean events per second across all log groups of the environment over the time range: the sum of the per-group means in the panel below.
panels.title: Log Events / s

panels.description: Bytes ingested by all log groups of the environment over the time range (the sum of the Ingest Volume by Group panel).
panels.title: Ingest Volume

panels.description: ERROR and CRITICAL lines across every service over the time range (the sum of the Errors by Service panel).
panels.title: Errors

panels.description: Subscription-filter deliveries that failed or were throttled (`DeliveryErrors` + `DeliveryThrottling`) for the environment's log groups. The API group's filter forwards security and operation audit records to the audit Firehose; anything above zero means audit records were not delivered.
panels.title: Audit Delivery Failures

panels.description: Events written per second to each log group under `/robosystems/${env}/`, from the CloudWatch `IncomingLogEvents` metric at the period Grafana picks for the time range. Series are named by the group's last path segment.
panels.title: Log Events / s by Group

panels.description: Bytes ingested per period by each log group (`IncomingBytes`, summed over the period Grafana picks for the time range). CloudWatch bills ingestion per GB, so this is the cost view of logging; the legend total is the bytes ingested in the time range.
panels.title: Ingest Volume by Group

panels.description: ERROR and CRITICAL lines per interval across every log group of the environment, named by the group's last path segment. Lines are matched on the structured `level` field where the service writes JSON, and on the level word in the text where it does not (Dagster's own lines, uvicorn access lines). Dagster run logs carry application lines in both Dagster's and the application's format, so its count runs high.

targets.expression:
parse @log /\/(?<service>[^\/]+)$/
| filter level in ["ERROR", "CRITICAL"] or (not ispresent(level) and @message like /ERROR|CRITICAL/)
| stats count(*) as errors by bin($__interval), service
| limit 10000

panels.title: Errors by Service

panels.description: WARNING lines per interval across every log group of the environment, excluding the SECURITY_AUDIT records, which are shown on their own. Lines are matched on the structured `level` field where the service writes JSON, and on the level word in the text where it does not (Dagster's own lines, uvicorn access lines). Dagster's run containers re-emit their startup and Python runtime warnings on every run, so Dagster dominates; click its legend entry to hide it.

targets.expression:
parse @log /\/(?<service>[^\/]+)$/
| filter (level = "WARNING" or (not ispresent(level) and @message like /WARNING/)) and @message not like /SECURITY_AUDIT/
| stats count(*) as warnings by bin($__interval), service
| limit 10000

panels.title: Warnings by Service

panels.description: SECURITY_AUDIT records written by the API's security audit logger, by event type: authentication failures, denied authorization, rate limiting, invalid keys and tokens, abuse signals. Routine `auth_success` and `token_refresh` events are excluded so the signals stay visible. The same records are forwarded to the audit bucket by the subscription filter.

targets.expression:
filter @message like /SECURITY_AUDIT/
| parse message /"event_type": "(?<event_type>[^"]+)"/
| filter event_type not in ["auth_success", "token_refresh"]
| stats count(*) as events by bin($__interval), event_type
| limit 10000

panels.title: Security Events by Type

panels.description: Distinct ERROR and CRITICAL messages across every service, by how often they occurred in the time range, with the last occurrence. JSON lines aggregate on their `message` field; text lines are compared on their first 200 characters, so Dagster's own lines, which start with a timestamp, mostly appear once each.

targets.expression:
parse @log /\/(?<service>[^\/]+)$/
| fields substr(coalesce(message, @message), 0, 200) as msg
| filter level in ["ERROR", "CRITICAL"] or (not ispresent(level) and @message like /ERROR|CRITICAL/)
| stats count(*) as hits, max(@timestamp) as last_seen by service, msg
| sort hits desc
| limit 25

panels.title: Top Error Messages

panels.description: API requests that completed with a 5xx status, newest first, from the `request_completed` records. `request_id` is the correlation id carried in the `X-Request-ID` response header; search the API Logs panel for it to see the request's other lines.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, message, duration_ms, user_id, request_id
| filter action = "request_completed" and status_code >= 500
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50

panels.title: Failed Requests (5xx)

panels.description: The 25 slowest successful API requests in the time range by `duration_ms`, with the user and request id. Health checks are fast enough never to appear.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, message, duration_ms, user_id, request_id
| filter action = "request_completed" and status_code < 500
| sort duration_ms desc
| limit 25

panels.title: Slowest Requests

panels.description: Authenticated API requests per user in the time range with the user's p95 and slowest request. Unauthenticated requests (health checks, failed logins) have no user and are not counted.

targets.expression:
filter action = "request_completed" and ispresent(user_id) and user_id != ""
| stats count(*) as requests, pct(duration_ms, 95) as p95_ms, max(duration_ms) as max_ms by user_id
| sort requests desc
| limit 25

panels.title: Requests by User

panels.description: Cypher queries the Graph API executed per database in the time range, from its `Query executed successfully` lines: count, mean, p95 and slowest duration, and rows returned. `sec` is the shared SEC repository; `kg…` ids are tenant graphs.

targets.expression:
parse message /Query executed successfully on (?<db>[^:]+): (?<rows>\d+) rows in (?<ms>[\d.]+)ms/
| filter ispresent(db)
| stats count(*) as queries, avg(ms) as avg_ms, pct(ms, 95) as p95_ms, max(ms) as max_ms, sum(rows) as rows_returned by db
| sort queries desc
| limit 25

panels.title: Graph Queries by Database

panels.description: The API containers' log stream (`api/…`); the ADOT collector's stream in the same group is left out, as are the load balancer's successful `GET /v1/status` health checks. The Level and Search variables filter this panel; Search is a regular expression matched against the whole line. Newest 200 lines in the time range.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @logStream like /^api\// and @message not like /GET \/v1\/status - 200/
| filter @message like /$level/ and @message like /$search/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200

panels.title: API Logs

panels.description: The worker tasks that run materializations and other queued work. The Level and Search variables filter this panel; Search is a regular expression matched against the whole line. Newest 200 lines in the time range.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /$level/ and @message like /$search/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200

panels.title: Worker Logs

panels.description: Daemon, webserver and run streams of the Dagster deployment. Run logs repeat each application line in Dagster's own format, so exact duplicates are collapsed. The Level and Search variables filter this panel; Search is a regular expression matched against the whole line. Newest 200 lines in the time range.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /$level/ and @message like /$search/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200

panels.title: Dagster Logs

panels.description: Every LadybugDB instance's Graph API container, one stream per instance named `tier/instance/role`; the `GET /health` probes are left out. The Level and Search variables filter this panel; Search is a regular expression matched against the whole line. Newest 200 lines in the time range.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message not like /GET \/health/
| filter @message like /$level/ and @message like /$search/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200

panels.title: Graph API Logs

title: RoboSystems Logs
